title: Cost Mesh: experiments charter + quarterly ops sprint for batching, caching, quant
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Charter and operational plan for a cross-functional quarterly sprint that consolidates targeted field experiments to reduce inference unit cost across hosted and dedicated tiers. Focus areas: request-level batching heuristics, KV/prefix cache prefetch policy, and quantization profile trials (int8/4-bit + calibration). This ticket captures the success metrics, experiment guardrails, rollout gating, staffing plan, and links to artifacts (PRD, dashboards, experiment templates).
objectives_and_key_results: OKR1: Reduce average hosted per-token cost by 18% for conversational workloads by EOM Q2
OKR2: Maintain model-quality regression under 0.5% top-line metric (per eval suite) during quantized rollouts
OKR3: Achieve 20% cache hit rate lift on high-reuse endpoints through proactive prefetch policies
success_metrics: unit_cost_reduction: percent change in $/1M tokens vs baseline (target -18%)
latency_SLOs: p50 and p95 within +5ms of baseline for P99-critical routes
quality_regressions: A/B eval delta on eval-set (target < 0.5% degradation)
cache_hit_rate: absolute increase in KV/prefix cache hits (target +20% on flagged routes)
milestones: 2026-03-10: Small-scale batcher trials on dedicated cluster (ENG-23114)
2026-03-24: Quantization field trial with fallback canary (ENG-23890)
2026-04-01: Sprint wrap + consolidated cost analysis report
experiment_plan: Batching: deploy adaptive micro-batcher to 5% of traffic for 48h windows; vary max_batch_size and max_wait_ms; measure token throughput, p95 latency, and cost per effective token
Caching: implement predictive prefetch for top-50 long-running sessions; compare TTL strategies and CPU trade-offs; instrument cache hit metrics and false-prefetch rate
Quantization: run post-training quant+calibration on two model families; apply staged canary (5% -> 25% traffic) with automatic rollback on quality drift; compare speedups and memory usage
guardrails_and_rollout_policy: Automatic rollback trigger if eval regression > 0.5% on control set or user-facing error rate spikes > 0.1%
Latency budget violation (p95 increase > 10%) pauses experiment and alerts SRE on-call
Canary traffic windows limited to non-critical customer segments unless explicit sales consent
Telemetry: every experiment must emit unified schema events to cost-ops dashboard (cost_delta, quality_delta, hit_rate)
acceptance_criteria: Charter reviewed and approved by Eng, SRE, Design, and Legal
Experiment runbooks and monitoring playbooks created and linked in artifacts
Dashboards receive live signals for cost + quality metrics with 1min granularity
At least one experiment demonstrates >8% unit cost reduction without quality regressions
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: quantization introduces subtle hallucination regressions - Mitigation: strict eval gates + human review set for semantic tests
Risk: prefetch increases CPU/IO load - Mitigation: cap concurrency and measure cost offset vs cache hit benefit
Risk: batching increases tail latency for synchronous low-latency routes - Mitigation: route-based opt-out and latency-aware batching thresholds
